Same scale and grasp as original, total length only 10 percent longer. No fire/ice cloud, no large glow. All views share this same design and cooling components, correct foreshortening.

Edit this isolated 4x4 fictional science-fiction game prop sheet. Keep EXACT cell order, directions, transparency and one prop per cell. White and black only, dark crisp outline, restrained soft shading compatible with our small engineer astronaut game. No characters, hands, anatomy, feet, text, projectiles, muzzle flashes, violence or background. True transparent RGBA. Preserve the original four rows and aiming directions.
